papers.title: Connecting diet and disease: Using Mendelian randomisation to bridge the gap
papers.translated_title: 连接饮食与疾病：利用孟德尔随机化弥合差距
papers.author: Deslandes, B.
papers.summary: Establishing causality in nutrition research is challenging. While randomised controlled trials (RCTs) provide robust evidence, long-term dietary intervention studies with disease endpoints are often impractical. Short-term RCTs can instead identify intermediate traits that may lie on the causal pathway between diet and disease. Mendelian randomisation (MR) is an epidemiological approach that uses genetic variants as proxies for modifiable exposures to estimate the effects of lifelong differences in exposure on disease risk. However, the utility of MR is limited for complex dietary patterns because genetic variants typically reflect biological mechanisms rather than specific diets. We propose a two-step framework integrating dietary RCTs with MR to infer potential lifetime effects of dietary interventions. First, RCT data identify molecular traits altered by an intervention. Second, MR evaluates whether these traits are associated with long-term disease risk. We demonstrate this framework using the Diabetes Remission Clinical Trial (DiRECT), which measured circulating proteins and diabetes remission. Using protein data alone, 216 of 4,601 proteins changed following the intervention (step 1), and 10 were associated with diabetes risk using MR (step 2). We then compared these MR estimates with observed protein-remission associations from DiRECT. The broad agreement between the two (r{approx}-0.645, R2=0.416) supports this framework as a useful approach for estimating long-term effects of dietary interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 在营养研究中建立因果关系具有挑战性。随机对照试验（RCT）虽能提供有力证据，但以疾病终点进行的长期饮食干预研究往往不切实际。短期RCT则可识别可能位于饮食与疾病因果通路上的中间性状。孟德尔随机化（MR）是一种流行病学方法，利用遗传变异作为可改变暴露的代理指标，以估计终生暴露差异对疾病风险的影响。然而，MR在复杂饮食模式中的实用性有限，因为遗传变异通常反映的是生物学机制而非特定饮食。我们提出一个两步框架，将饮食RCT与MR相结合，以推断饮食干预的潜在终生效应。第一步，RCT数据识别被干预改变的分子性状。第二步，MR评估这些性状是否与长期疾病风险相关。我们使用糖尿病缓解临床试验（DiRECT）来展示该框架，该试验测量了循环蛋白和糖尿病缓解。仅使用蛋白数据，4,601种蛋白中有216种在干预后发生变化（第一步），其中10种通过MR与糖尿病风险相关（第二步）。随后，我们将这些MR估计值与DiRECT中观察到的蛋白-缓解关联进行比较。两者之间的广泛一致性（r{approx}-0.645，R2=0.416）支持该框架作为估计饮食干预长期效应的一种有用方法。

papers.title: Assessment of frailty in older adults: Psychometric properties of the Multidimensional Frailty Scale (MFS)
papers.translated_title: 老年人衰弱评估：多维衰弱量表（MFS）的心理测量学特性
papers.author: Gorostiaga, A.
papers.summary: Frailty is increasingly recognised as a multidimensional construct. However, existing instruments assessing multidimensional frailty either show limited validity evidence or fail to adequately cover all the proposed theoretical dimensions. To address this gap, we recently developed the preliminary items of the Multidimensional Frailty Scale (MFS), a new instrument designed to assess physical, cognitive, affective, social and environmental frailty in older adults. This study sought to determine the definitive item set and to evaluate the psychometric properties of the final version. We conducted a cross-sectional observational study with 283 individuals. Participants completed the preliminary 51-item version of the MFS, together with other measures of related constructs and a sociodemographic questionnaire. Item analysis yielded a final 29-item version of the MFS. Confirmatory factor analysis supported a five-factor second-order model with excellent fit to the data. Internal consistency was high for all dimensions and the total scale. Convergent validity was supported by moderate-to-strong correlations between corresponding MFS and TFI dimensions. Similarly, the expected associations of the MFS with age, loneliness, life satisfaction and independence in activities of daily living provided validity evidence based on relations to other variables. Overall, the MFS has robust psychometric properties and constitutes a brief yet comprehensive instrument for assessing multidimensional frailty. Its hierarchical structure allows both global and domain-specific assessment, supporting more precise identification of frailty profiles. These features make the MFS suitable for use in both applied settings and research, which may contribute to earlier detection and better targeting of preventive strategies for older adults.
papers.translated_summary: 衰弱日益被视为一种多维构念。然而，现有的多维衰弱评估工具要么效度证据有限，要么未能充分涵盖所有提出的理论维度。为弥补这一空白，我们近期初步编制了多维衰弱量表（MFS）的条目，这是一种旨在评估老年人躯体、认知、情感、社会和环境衰弱的新工具。本研究旨在确定最终条目集，并评估最终版本的心理测量学特性。我们开展了一项横断面观察性研究，纳入283名个体。参与者完成了包含51个条目的MFS初步版本，以及其他相关构念的测量工具和一份社会人口学问卷。条目分析产生了包含29个条目的MFS最终版本。验证性因子分析支持一个五因子二阶模型，且与数据拟合极佳。所有维度及总量表的内部一致性均较高。相应的MFS与TFI维度之间存在中至强相关，支持了聚合效度。同样，MFS与年龄、孤独感、生活满意度及日常生活活动独立性的预期关联，为基于与其他变量关系的效度提供了证据。总体而言，MFS具有稳健的心理测量学特性，是一种简短而全面的多维衰弱评估工具。其层级结构允许进行整体和领域特异性评估，支持更精确地识别衰弱特征。这些特点使MFS既适用于应用场景，也适用于研究，可能有助于老年人衰弱的早期发现和预防策略的更精准定位。

papers.title: Structural Brain Networks and the Seizure-Survival Paradox in Glioblastoma
papers.translated_title: 胶质母细胞瘤中的结构性脑网络与癫痫-生存悖论
papers.author: Zhou, D. J.
papers.summary: Background: In glioblastoma, tumor-related epilepsy (TRE) is paradoxically associated with longer survival, but the mechanism is unclear. We hypothesized that structural connectivity is associated with seizure susceptibility and survival, and tested whether these associations are independent or mediated. Methods: We retrospectively studied glioblastoma patients with preoperative diffusion-weighted MRI. Fractional anisotropy-weighted connectivity matrices were constructed using lesion-aware tractography. Mean edge weight and local efficiency were computed per Yeo 7-network and with global efficiency at hemisphere and whole-brain levels. Associations with TRE, overall survival (OS), and progression-free survival (PFS) were assessed using logistic regression and Cox proportional hazards models with false discovery rate correction. Causal mediation analysis tested whether connectivity and TRE mediate each other's relationship with overall survival. Results: We included 420 glioblastoma patients. Of 406 classifiable for TRE, 217 (53%) had TRE. TRE was associated with higher local efficiency across all seven contralateral networks (d=0.42-0.49, q<0.010) and five of seven ipsilateral networks (d=0.44-0.49, q<0.050). In adjusted models, higher contralateral global efficiency was associated with longer OS (HR 0.84, q=0.021), with no metric associated with PFS. TRE did not mediate the connectivity-OS relationship. Contralateral local efficiency partially mediated the TRE-OS association when postoperative KPS was excluded from the model (ACME 16.6 days, 7.8% mediated, p=0.029), though this was attenuated when KPS was included (p=0.074). Conclusions: Structural connectivity partially mediates the seizure-survival association, suggesting preserved network architecture may contribute to why seizure patients survive longer, though the majority of the effect operates through other pathways.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在胶质母细胞瘤中，肿瘤相关癫痫（TRE） paradoxically 与更长的生存期相关，但其机制尚不清楚。我们假设结构连接性与癫痫易感性和生存期相关，并检验这些关联是独立的还是由中介介导的。方法：我们回顾性研究了术前行扩散加权MRI的胶质母细胞瘤患者。使用病灶感知的纤维束成像构建了分数各向异性加权的连接矩阵。按Yeo 7网络计算平均边权重和局部效率，并在半球和全脑水平计算全局效率。使用逻辑回归和Cox比例风险模型评估与TRE、总生存期（OS）和无进展生存期（PFS）的关联，并进行错误发现率校正。因果中介分析检验了连接性和TRE是否介导彼此与总生存期的关系。结果：我们纳入了420例胶质母细胞瘤患者。在406例可分类TRE的患者中，217例（53%）患有TRE。TRE与所有七个对侧网络的更高局部效率相关（d=0.42-0.49，q<0.010），并与七个同侧网络中的五个相关（d=0.44-0.49，q<0.050）。在调整后的模型中，更高的对侧全局效率与更长的OS相关（HR 0.84，q=0.021），但没有指标与PFS相关。TRE并未介导连接性-OS关系。当术后KPS被排除在模型之外时，对侧局部效率部分介导了TRE-OS关联（ACME 16.6天，7.8%被介导，p=0.029），尽管当纳入KPS时该效应减弱（p=0.074）。结论：结构连接性部分介导了癫痫-生存期关联，提示保留的网络架构可能有助于解释为何癫痫患者生存更久，尽管大部分效应通过其他途径发挥作用。

papers.title: The COVID-19 Trajectory in Israel: A Comprehensive Analysis of National Surveillance Data on Documented Infections, Test Positivity, and Vaccine-Effectiveness Estimates
papers.translated_title: 以色列COVID-19疫情轨迹：对记录感染、检测阳性率及疫苗有效性估计的国家监测数据综合分析
papers.author: Ophir, Y.
papers.summary: Background: Israel was among the first countries to implement nationwide BNT162b2 vaccination and became an important source of real-world evidence during the COVID-19 pandemic. The present study aimed to characterize the long-term national epidemic trajectory and the evolution of vaccination-associated differences in documented infection across the course of the pandemic. Methods: Five Israeli Ministry of Health datasets were analyzed from February 2020 through May 2023. National trends in documented infection and test positivity were characterized. Vaccinated-unvaccinated differences were examined using routine-surveillance case rates. To reduce potential bias from differences in prior-infection history and real-world testing intensity, a second age-adjusted analysis compared test positivity among individuals without documented prior infection. Results: The two completed pre-rollout waves declined to [≤]10% of their peaks within 32 and 43 days, whereas the winter 2020-2021 wave, already underway when vaccination began, required 68 days. Delta and Omicron peaks were 17% and approximately ninefold higher than the January 2021 peak. Routine-surveillance apparent vaccine effectiveness peaked at 94.4% in February 2021, declined to 61.5% by late May, and remained negative from February 2022 onward. The age-adjusted test-positivity analysis among individuals without documented prior infection yielded generally lower estimates, which remained negative from December 2021 onward. Conclusions: Overall, the early vaccination-associated advantage against documented infection was not stable over extended follow-up. While these observational findings cannot establish causal vaccine effects or address severe outcomes, they underscore the importance of evaluating vaccine-effectiveness estimates over extended follow-up as population immunity, testing practices, and viral variants evolve.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：以色列是最早实施全国范围BNT162b2疫苗接种的国家之一，并成为COVID-19大流行期间真实世界证据的重要来源。本研究旨在描述长期全国流行轨迹以及大流行过程中疫苗接种相关差异在记录感染方面的演变。方法：分析了以色列卫生部2020年2月至2023年5月的五个数据集。描述了记录感染和检测阳性的全国趋势。使用常规监测病例率检查已接种疫苗与未接种疫苗之间的差异。为减少既往感染史差异和真实世界检测强度可能带来的偏倚，第二项年龄调整分析比较了无记录既往感染个体的检测阳性率。结果：两个已完成的前推广波次在32天和43天内降至其峰值的[≤]10%，而2020-2021年冬季波次在疫苗接种开始时已在进行中，需要68天。Delta和Omicron峰值分别比2021年1月峰值高17%和约九倍。常规监测显示的表观疫苗有效性在2021年2月达到94.4%的峰值，到5月下旬降至61.5%，并从2022年2月起持续为负。在无记录既往感染个体中进行的年龄调整检测阳性分析得出的估计值总体较低，并从2021年12月起持续为负。结论：总体而言，早期与疫苗接种相关的针对记录感染的优势在延长随访中并不稳定。虽然这些观察性发现不能确立因果疫苗效应或解决重症结局，但它们强调在人群免疫、检测实践和病毒变异株演变过程中，对延长随访中的疫苗有效性估计进行评估的重要性。

papers.title: Integrating Wearable Sensor Technology into Outpatient Rehabilitation Care: A Proof-of-Concept Study
papers.translated_title: 将可穿戴传感器技术整合到门诊康复护理中：一项概念验证研究
papers.author: Miller, A.
papers.summary: Background: The disconnect between episodic in-clinic assessments and patients goals to improve activity in daily life presents a challenge in rehabilitation. Wearable sensors are promising for addressing this disconnect but are not part of routine practice. The purpose of this study was to develop and test a digital health solution that integrated wearable sensor technology into outpatient rehabilitation. Methods: Using an iterative user-centered design approach, a digital solution was built that integrated data from a wrist sensor into the electronic health record (EHR). The feasibility, usability, and resources required of the solution were evaluated in a 9-month proof-of-concept study in outpatient rehabilitation. Results: 17 clinicians and 38 patients (median monitoring duration: 42 days) participated. Patient adherence to daily data syncing was a median of 68.6% and was not significantly correlated with digital technology self-efficacy (r = 0.03, p = 0.86). Recent sensor data ([≤] 3 days old) were available in the EHR for 90.2% (193/214) of clinic visits, and clinicians viewed these data in 81.9% (158/193) of these visits. Overall user-friendliness on the System Usability Scale received a median rating of "good" from both patients and clinicians. Resources included costs to build the data transfer pipeline, a 24-month build timeline, and ongoing technical support. Conclusions: By combining user-centered design principles with dedicated resources, we built a feasible and usable digital health solution to bridge the gap between brief clinic visits and daily life in outpatient rehabilitation. These results and future refinements will facilitate broader-scale implementation of sensor technology in rehabilitation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：发作性临床评估与患者改善日常生活活动能力的目标之间的脱节，给康复带来了挑战。可穿戴传感器有望解决这种脱节，但尚未成为常规实践的一部分。本研究的目的是开发并测试一种将可穿戴传感器技术整合到门诊康复中的数字健康解决方案。方法：采用以用户为中心的迭代设计方法，构建了一种数字解决方案，将腕部传感器的数据整合到电子健康记录（EHR）中。在为期9个月的门诊康复概念验证研究中，评估了该解决方案的可行性、可用性和所需资源。结果：17名临床医生和38名患者（中位监测时长：42天）参与了研究。患者对每日数据同步的依从性中位数为68.6%，且与数字技术自我效能无显著相关性（r = 0.03，p = 0.86）。在90.2%（193/214）的临床就诊中，EHR中可获取近期传感器数据（[≤] 3天），临床医生在81.9%（158/193）的此类就诊中查看了这些数据。患者和临床医生对系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale）的总体用户友好性评分中位数均为“良好”。所需资源包括构建数据传输管道的成本、24个月的构建时间表以及持续的技术支持。结论：通过将以用户为中心的设计原则与专门的资源相结合，我们构建了一种可行且可用的数字健康解决方案，以弥合门诊康复中短暂临床就诊与日常生活之间的差距。这些结果及未来的改进将促进传感器技术在康复中更广泛的实施。

papers.title: Relevance of Seasonal Revaccination against Respiratory Syncytial Virus in Hematology Patients: First Insights in Stem Cell Transplant Recipients
papers.translated_title: 血液病患者中呼吸道合胞病毒季节性再接种的相关性：干细胞移植受者的初步见解
papers.author: redjoul, r.
papers.summary: Several vaccines against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) have been commercialized recently. Their immediate immunogenicity in various conditions of immunosuppression, including patients receiving allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), have been reported in 2025 by different teams, including ours. In immunocompromised patients, the duration of vaccinal humoral protection as well as the relevance of seasonal revaccination is still unknown. By analyzing the kinetics of humoral responses after a single dose of bivalent RSVpreF vaccine over 12 months in 71 HSCT recipients, we show that annual revaccination benefits mostly those primarily vaccinated within the early 18 months after HSCT. We also provide a first evaluation of vaccinal clinical effectiveness in HSCT patients.
papers.translated_summary: 针对呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）的几种疫苗近期已实现商业化。不同团队（包括我们的团队）已于2025年报道了这些疫苗在多种免疫抑制状态下（包括接受异基因造血干细胞移植（HSCT）的患者）的即时免疫原性。在免疫功能低下患者中，疫苗体液保护的持续时间以及季节性再接种的相关性仍不清楚。通过分析71名HSCT受者在接种单剂二价RSVpreF疫苗后12个月内的体液应答动力学，我们发现年度再接种主要惠及在HSCT后早期18个月内首次接种疫苗者。我们还首次提供了HSCT患者中疫苗临床有效性的评估。

papers.title: From Anatomy to Aneurysm: Morphological-Hemodynamic Coupling and Predictive Modeling in Aberrant Splenic Artery.
papers.translated_title: 从解剖到动脉瘤：异常脾动脉的形态学-血流动力学耦合与预测建模
papers.author: XU, R.
papers.summary: Background: Aberrant splenic artery (SA), defined as the SA arising from the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) rather than the celiac axis, is a rare anatomical variant with a prevalence of less than 1% in the general population. Although clinical observations suggest that individuals with this variant are highly susceptible to developing SA aneurysms (SAAs), the underlying pathophysiological mechanisms remain poorly understood. Objectives: This study aimed to systematically investigate the morphological and hemodynamic features of aberrant SA anatomy and their contributions to SAA formation, and to develop a predictive model for individualized risk stratification. Methods: This multi-center retrospective cohort study enrolled 195 patients with aberrant SA anatomy from 16 centers across China between January 2008 and June 2026, including 94 patients with concomitant SAAs and 101 without. In addition, 100 patients with common SAAs and 100 non-aneurysmal controls with normal vascular anatomy were enrolled for comparative analysis. Three-dimensional vascular models were reconstructed from computed tomography angiography? (CTA) images, and twelve morphological parameters were measured. Computational fluid dynamics simulations were performed to analyze fourteen hemodynamic parameters. A two-stage machine learning model based on five morphological parameters was developed to predict SAA occurrence and location. Results: Aberrant SAAs were significantly larger and predominantly located in the proximal SA, whereas common SAAs were mainly located in the distal splenic hilum. Morphological analysis revealed that the aberrant SA exhibited a smaller branching angle with its parent vessel, an increased SA/SMA cross-sectional area ratio, and a higher tortuosity index. Hemodynamic analysis demonstrated significantly lower time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS) at the proximal SA in aberrant anatomy, whereas the SA-parent vessel junction showed elevated oscillatory shear index (OSI), which was inversely correlated with the branching angle. Longitudinal follow-up of non-aneurysmal patients (n=14; mean follow-up, 36.8 months) showed stable vessel dimensions over time. The KNN-based predictive model achieved an AUROC of 0.828 for predicting SAA occurrence and was deployed as an interactive web application (the zs_abeSA model) for clinical use. Conclusions: Aberrant SA anatomy is an independent risk factor for SAA formation. The pathogenic mechanism involves a cascade from morphological remodeling to hemodynamic derangement, ultimately leading to aneurysm formation at the proximal SA. The zs_abeSA model provides a practical tool for individualized risk assessment and clinical decision-making, with direct implications for screening, surveillance, and therapeutic strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：异常脾动脉（SA），定义为脾动脉起源于肠系膜上动脉（SMA）而非腹腔干，是一种罕见的解剖变异，在普通人群中的患病率低于1%。尽管临床观察提示具有该变异的个体极易发生脾动脉瘤（SAA），但其潜在的病理生理机制仍知之甚少。目的：本研究旨在系统探讨异常脾动脉解剖的形态学和血流动力学特征及其对脾动脉瘤形成的贡献，并构建预测模型以实现个体化风险分层。方法：本多中心回顾性队列研究纳入2008年1月至2026年6月期间来自中国16个中心的195例异常脾动脉解剖患者，其中94例合并脾动脉瘤，101例未合并。此外，还纳入100例普通脾动脉瘤患者和100例血管解剖正常的非动脉瘤对照者进行对比分析。基于计算机断层血管造影（CTA）图像重建三维血管模型，并测量12项形态学参数。进行计算流体动力学模拟以分析14项血流动力学参数。构建基于5项形态学参数的两阶段机器学习模型，以预测脾动脉瘤的发生及位置。结果：异常脾动脉瘤显著较大，且主要位于脾动脉近端，而普通脾动脉瘤主要位于脾门远端。形态学分析显示，异常脾动脉与其父血管的分支角度较小，脾动脉/肠系膜上动脉横截面积比增大，迂曲指数较高。血流动力学分析表明，异常解剖中脾动脉近端的时间平均壁面剪切应力（TAWSS）显著降低，而脾动脉-父血管交界处显示振荡剪切指数（OSI）升高，且与分支角度呈负相关。对非动脉瘤患者的纵向随访（n=14；平均随访36.8个月）显示血管尺寸随时间保持稳定。基于KNN的预测模型预测脾动脉瘤发生的AUROC为0.828，并已部署为交互式网络应用程序（zs_abeSA模型）供临床使用。结论：异常脾动脉解剖是脾动脉瘤形成的独立危险因素。其致病机制涉及从形态学重塑到血流动力学紊乱的级联过程，最终导致脾动脉近端动脉瘤形成。zs_abeSA模型为个体化风险评估和临床决策提供了实用工具，对筛查、监测和治疗策略具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: A Comparative Analysis of Signal Quality and Morphological Fidelity in ECG Smartwatches
papers.translated_title: 心电图智能手表信号质量与形态保真度的比较分析
papers.author: Muhammed, S. M.
papers.summary: This study provides a direct and objective comparison of ECG signal quality and morphological feature preservation across four leading commercial smartwatches: the Apple Watch Series 9, Samsung Galaxy Watch 6, Fitbit Sense 2, and Withings ScanWatch, using a controlled dataset. The Philips TC30 is used as the reference standard. ECG signal quality is assessed using Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Standard Deviation of Baseline Wander, and Power Spectral Density (PSD). Preservation of morphological features is assessed by comparing the performance of our automatic J-point and ST deviation detection algorithms when applied separately to recordings from each smartwatch. J-point detection is evaluated by comparing each device's performance against the reference device, while ST deviation is assessed using simulator-defined ground truth values. The Apple Watch and Withings ScanWatch achieved the best SNR, while the Samsung Galaxy Watch showed substantially lower values. The Withings ScanWatch demonstrated the most stable baseline, whereas the Fitbit Sense 2 showed the greatest baseline variability. All devices exhibited a consistent negative bias in J-point detection, suggesting that internal signal processing tends to smooth small changes in waveforms. For ST-segment classification, the Apple Watch achieved the most balanced performance in terms of sensitivity and specificity. These results provide researchers and clinicians with data-driven guidance for selecting the most appropriate device for their specific needs.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究利用受控数据集，对四款领先的商用智能手表——Apple Watch Series 9、Samsung Galaxy Watch 6、Fitbit Sense 2 和 Withings ScanWatch——在 ECG 信号质量和形态特征保留方面进行了直接、客观的比较。以 Philips TC30 作为参考标准。ECG 信号质量通过信噪比（SNR）、基线漂移标准差和功率谱密度（PSD）进行评估。形态特征的保留则通过比较我们的自动 J 点和 ST 偏差检测算法分别应用于每款智能手表记录时的性能来评估。J 点检测通过将各设备的性能与参考设备进行比较来评估，而 ST 偏差则使用模拟器定义的 ground truth 值进行评估。Apple Watch 和 Withings ScanWatch 获得了最佳的 SNR，而 Samsung Galaxy Watch 则显示出显著较低的值。Withings ScanWatch 表现出最稳定的基线，而 Fitbit Sense 2 则显示出最大的基线变异性。所有设备在 J 点检测中均表现出一致的负偏差，表明内部信号处理倾向于平滑波形中的微小变化。对于 ST 段分类，Apple Watch 在敏感性和特异性方面取得了最均衡的性能。这些结果为研究人员和临床医生提供了数据驱动的指导，以便根据其具体需求选择最合适的设备。

papers.title: A Dual-Species Plant-derived Extracellular Vesicle and Growth Factors Formulation for Hair and Scalp Care: A Randomized, Placebo-controlled Study
papers.translated_title: 一种用于头发和头皮护理的双物种植物来源细胞外囊泡与生长因子配方：一项随机、安慰剂对照研究
papers.author: Chang, T.-M.
papers.summary: Scalp dysregulation and hair shedding are common cosmetic concerns, driving an increasing demand for non-pharmaceutical interventions, including plant-derived extracellular vesicles (EV) and growth factors. This randomized controlled trial evaluated the efficacy of topical formulations in 60 healthy adults over a 56-day period, monitoring scalp and hair parameters at Days 14, 28, 42, and 56 relative to baseline (Day 0). Group A: placebo; Group B: base (placebo containing 0.1% caffeine and panthenol); Group C: base + recombinant Fc-fusion long-acting insulin-like growth factor-1 (rIGF-1) and fibroblast growth factor-7 (rFGF-7); Group D: base + Centella asiatica (C. asiatica) + ginger EVs; and Group E: base + rIGF-1, rFGF-7, and C. asiatica + ginger EVs. Group E demonstrated rapid onset and significant superiority over the control and other treatment groups across all parameters. In scalp regulation, Group E achieved a highly significant, time-dependent reduction in excess sebum, reaching a 67% decrease by Day 56. Hair growth kinetics were significantly accelerated in Group E, with a mean cumulative length increase approaching 3.9 cm by Day 56, driven by a surge in mean weekly growth velocity to 1.4 cm/week. Group E also demonstrated the highest improvements in hair thickness (19 m) and hair density (17% increase) by Day 56. Finally, hair shedding was reduced by almost half by Day 56 in Group E. These results demonstrate that the formulation delivers a clinically superior non-pharmaceutical intervention for advanced hair and scalp revitalization.
papers.translated_summary: 头皮失调和脱发是常见的美容问题，推动了包括植物来源细胞外囊泡（EV）和生长因子在内的非药物干预需求不断增长。本随机对照试验评估了局部外用配方在60名健康成人中为期56天的疗效，并在第14、28、42和56天相对于基线（第0天）监测头皮和头发参数。A组：安慰剂；B组：基质（含0.1%咖啡因和泛醇的安慰剂）；C组：基质+重组Fc融合长效胰岛素样生长因子-1（rIGF-1）和成纤维细胞生长因子-7（rFGF-7）；D组：基质+积雪草（C. asiatica）+姜EV；E组：基质+rIGF-1、rFGF-7以及积雪草+姜EV。E组在所有参数上均表现出起效迅速，并显著优于对照组和其他治疗组。在头皮调节方面，E组实现了高度显著且时间依赖性的多余皮脂减少，至第56天时减少达67%。E组的头发生长动力学显著加快，至第56天时平均累积长度增加接近3.9 cm，这由平均每周生长速度激增至1.4 cm/周所驱动。至第56天时，E组在头发粗细（19 m）和头发密度（增加17%）方面也表现出最大改善。最后，E组至第56天时脱发减少近一半。这些结果表明，该配方为高级头发和头皮焕活提供了一种临床更优的非药物干预。

papers.title: Wastewater Metagenomic Virome Analysis of the 2026 World Cup in Texas
papers.translated_title: 2026年得克萨斯世界杯废水宏基因组病毒组分析
papers.author: Perez, R. K.
papers.summary: Mass gatherings are thought to create conditions for pathogen introduction and spread, yet whether such events measurably alter the viral community of a city has rarely been tested against an extensive historical baseline. We analyzed 5,137 hybrid-capture metagenomic wastewater samples collected from 55 sites across 17 Texas cities between June 2022 and July 2026, spanning the 2026 FIFA World Cup. We asked (1) whether host-city viral community composition during the tournament departed from its established summer-to-summer range, (2) whether targeted respiratory viruses rose above their characteristic summer trend, and (3) whether the load of rare and novel taxa was elevated in host cities relative to non-host cities. Despite the plausibility of these hypotheses, we detected no tournament-associated perturbations. Although based on a single event, these findings favor continuous wastewater surveillance over event-triggered deployment, both for detecting introductions that arrive unpredictably and for supplying the baseline against which any event should be judged.
papers.translated_summary: 大规模集会被认为会为病原体的引入和传播创造条件，但此类事件是否可测量地改变一座城市的病毒群落，鲜有研究以广泛的历史基线加以检验。我们分析了2022年6月至2026年7月期间从德克萨斯州17个城市55个采样点采集的5，137份杂交捕获宏基因组废水样本，时间跨度涵盖2026年国际足联世界杯。我们提出三个问题：(1)赛事期间主办城市的病毒群落组成是否偏离其既有的夏季至夏季波动范围，(2)目标呼吸道病毒是否超出其典型的夏季趋势，(3)主办城市中稀有和新出现类群的载量相对于非主办城市是否升高。尽管这些假设看似合理，我们未检测到与赛事相关的扰动。尽管基于单一事件，这些发现支持持续废水监测而非事件触发的部署，既可用于检测不可预测到来的病原体引入，也可为评判任何事件提供基线。
